caseNameFull: United Steelworkers of America, AFL-CIO-CLC v. Weber Kaiser Aluminum & Chemical Corp. v. Weber and United States v. Weber

opinions.text: C. A. 5th Cir. Certiorari granted, cases consolidated, and a total of one and one-half hours allotted for oral argument. Mr. Justice Stevens took no part in the consideration or decision of these petitions. Reported below: 563 F. 2d 216.
